message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' shows four categories. The printed labels and the visual proportions of the pie slices both indicate that Nuclear is the largest category at 45%, followed by Hydroelectric at 30%, Fossil Fuels at 15%, and Renewables at 10%. The routing criterion is to identify the largest global energy consumption category and route it to priority source monitoring. Therefore, Nuclear is the correct source to escalate." , "option_label": "Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring"}
